properties.notes: Development should be in line with the Ancoats & New Islington Neighbourhood Development Framework Update 2016 http://www.manchester.gov.uk/downloads/download/6622/ancoats_and_new_islington_neighbourhood_framework_dec_2016. Approx 'MinNetDwellings' expected however proposals for a higher number of dwellings will be considered. No maximum has been set but all proposals must be in line with the Council's design quality requirements, the Ancoats & New Islington Neighbourhood Development Framework Update 2016 and any other relevant Council-endorsed planning framework or masterplan
